items.text: Puka Nacua listed IN for Week 4 after hip injury; expected to return vs Eagles with possible snap limits per speculation.
items.why: Full practice progression; McVay expects play
items.implication: WR1 return boosts Rams offense; monitor snaps

items.text: Nico Collins listed IN returning from hamstring; excellent matchup vs Cowboys.
items.why: Full participant Friday; good to go per reports
items.implication: Elite WR restart in high-implied points game

items.text: Justin Jefferson OUT (ankle) for Week 4 vs Dolphins.
items.implication: Major Vikings WR void; Addison surge

items.text: DeVonta Smith OUT (hamstring) vs Rams; Eagles also missing Goedert and Baun.
items.implication: Eagles pass catchers thinned; Brown/Goedert also out

items.text: Great to have Puka Nacua back from hip; speculation on possible limited snaps to monitor.
items.why: Return after multi-week absence; eye test strong historically
items.conflict: Possible snap limit vs full return

items.text: Excellent spot for Nico Collins return; Cowboys inflate opp WR scoring 7.3% (most NFL); Texans 7th-most implied points.
Jordan Addison truthers moment: home vs borderline secondary with Justin Jefferson out.
Dallas Goedert OUT (knee) for Week 4; Eagles elevate Ertz/Deguara.
Breece Hall OUT (quad); Jets RB snaps open.
LOVE Jaylen Warren: 90% snaps, 20/22 RB touches last week; Dowdle out; CLE allows 88+ rush yds every game. Top-10 play.
LOVE Jeremiyah Love: 26 touches, RB5 utilization; Giants allow 5.1 YPC; double-digit target share every game.
items.why: Explosive usage spike + soft run D

items.text: Tough start for Jadarian Price: lost GL to Wilson, pass to Holani, fumbles, chest hurt, Charbonnet practicing. Still passes eye test long-term.
items.implication: IR confirms short-term loss; monitor return
